dict.string: casa-desk reads your calendar so your assistants can answer questions about your schedule. It never changes or deletes events.
casa-desk reads your reminders so your assistants can tell you what is due. It never changes or deletes reminders.
casa-desk looks people up in your contacts so your assistants know who is who. It never changes or deletes contacts.
casa-desk reads your notes through the Notes app. It never changes or deletes notes.
